fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge width/capacity at busy A4019 junction arms serving a bus stop is a genuine Stage 1 preliminary-design safety issue for crossing pedestrians and cyclists, not a vacuous observation.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quote from EV-UK-015 directly supports the pivotal mechanism (narrow refuges exposing cyclists to clipping collisions), anchoring the check-provision recommendation.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a GG 119 Stage 1 safety concern rather than a compliance question, with the dimensional check appropriately deferred to design response.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: names exact locations (A4019 crossings adjacent the bus stop) and concrete dimensional criteria (pushchair plus cycle accommodation), and is deliverable at detailed design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Both pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly identified, with exposure scenarios (two-way conflicts, cyclist clipping) articulated for each.

justifications.substance: Verifying that assessed refuse-vehicle/7.5t box van envelopes (already showing limited over-run into opposing lanes) survive stop-line repositioning is a genuine geometric-compatibility issue at a signalised junction at preliminary-design stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal premise rests on the verbatim EV-UK-002 quote confirming the original swept-path assessment and its over-run caveat, combined with the recorded fact of stop-line repositioning near the junction.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a compliance_question distinct from an audit problem, with an explicit exception-check analog note and deliberate separation from VRU safety concerns.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: re-run the named large-vehicle swept-path analysis against the as-adjusted stop-line positions with a clear Stage 2 deadline.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrian and cyclist presence, refuges, and desire lines are explicitly acknowledged but correctly scoped out of this vehicle-specific check, warranting the acknowledged-not-applicable score of 1.
